scope: Applied manual workflow, bounded activation record, narrow integration-guard evolution and current-state documentation. This is a prepublication code review, not execution or remote CI evidence.
findings: Active workflow is byte-for-byte the Stage A reviewed template with the specified full immutable code SHA substituted.

Integration guard admits only the named workflow matching the immutable reviewed template and wrapper hashes plus activation record; unrelated secret-using workflows are still rejected.
Recorded old/new integration-gate hashes match the reviewed baseline and new gate.
Current-state documentation says the first manual start and real secret/connection verification remain pending, and does not report a Jev score, billing result or completed MASSIVE comparison.
